Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer hallucinated the manufacturer of the ASM-N-5 Gorgon V in its search results. In Step 2, the agent reported that the search results showed the missile was "developed by the Lockheed Martin Company" (or "Lockheed MartinCompany"). This is factually incorrect; the missile was built by the Glenn L. Martin Company. This error likely stemmed from the search engine's auto-completion or a glitch in the simulated search results where "Lockheed Martin" was inserted instead of "Glenn L. Martin," leading the agent to incorrectly update its understanding of the manufacturer. This hallucination caused the subsequent steps to rely on a false premise, although the Planner eventually corrected the record based on the original Step 1 results.
